face_basis.reason: Rounded otter volume, pale cheek/chest markings and flowing paired-fin/tail cues translate into broad soft cheeks, softly arched brows, full lips and medium wavy curtain-bang hair. Differs from angular short-haired Pachirisu and narrow-faced Flygon.
face_basis.final_face_line: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): softly rounded face, balanced length, wide width; soft rounded jaw; open rounded eyes, medium size, level outer corners, wide-set; fine soft arches; balanced nose; full lips.
